faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to create the caricature?
faq.a1: The artwork is completed within 2 days. If you chose a physical print (poster, canvas), add 3 business days for production and shipping.
faq.q2: Do people need to be in the same photo?
faq.a2: Not at all! Send us individual photos and our artists will draw everyone together in one image.
faq.q3: What happens if I'm not satisfied?
faq.a3: We offer unlimited free revisions until you are completely satisfied!
faq.q4: Can my pet also become a cartoon?
faq.a4: Absolutely! Dogs, cats, birds — we can transform any beloved pet into a cartoon character.
faq.q5: Can I also have objects or settings drawn?
faq.a5: Yes! We can include objects, vehicles, settings or accessories for a small extra fee.

tj.etapesSous: No account to create, no software. One photo is enough.
tj.temoinsTexte: More than 85,000 hand-drawn portraits have already made someone smile. Your turn?
tj.atoutsSous: Every portrait is hand-drawn by an illustrator. No AI, no templates.
tj.atout1D: Your first preview arrives within 2 days. Once you approve it, the high-resolution file is emailed to you.
tj.atout2D: We adjust until it is right, as many times as needed, at no extra cost.
tj.atout3D: Alone, as a couple, with family, with colleagues or with your pet. Several photos are welcome.
tj.atout4D: Encrypted transactions and a smooth order, from the digital file to the framed print.
tj.recitP1: It started with a simple idea: what if anyone could be turned into a cartoon character?
tj.recitP2: Today a team of illustrators redraws every order, one by one. No automatic generation, no filter: a drawing, made by someone.
tj.catSloganCinema: Become the star of your movie!
tj.hiwStep1Texte: Pick a background, choose the number of people and pets, choose shoulders-only or full-body, and leave notes for special requests.
tj.hiwStep2Texte: Upload photos from your device or social media — now or later — to create your cartoon portrait.
tj.hiwStep3Texte: Get your digital download in 2 days. Add a canvas, a framed poster, a mug, and more.
tj.ctaTexte: Support real illustrators and give a gift nobody else can give.
tj.piedBaseline: Hand-drawn portraits, made from your photos.
tj.contactHoraires: Reply within 24 h, Monday to Friday
